name: retro-book-store
description: Front-end build for RetroBookStore (Tailwind CSS + vendored JS).

scripts.vendor: mkdir -p static/js/vendor && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.min.js static/js/vendor/ && mv static/js/vendor/cdn.min.js static/js/vendor/alpine.min.js && sed -i '/sourceMappingURL/d' static/js/vendor/*.js
scripts.build: npm run vendor && npm run build:css
